clusters.description: Rune-aware string reverse — preserves unicode code points (different from slugify which is ASCII-only).
Aggregate (sum, count) of seq[int] — returns tuple, but aggregate not extremes (different from redteam maxPair).
Frequency count of seq[int] as seq[(value, count)] sorted by value ascending — exercises seq-of-tuples serialization.

Newton's method square root returning Option[float] — None for negative input. Exercises std/json's built-in Option[T] % overload. Inputs chosen to produce non-whole-number outputs (see Finding #2 in PR description — whole-number floats like 2.0 serialize as '2.0' in Nim but '2' in JS, breaking cross-stack parity).
Case-sensitive palindrome check (rune-aware). Returns bool — exercises bool return type serialization.
inputs: a man a plan a canal panama
